# Setup

This page renders a sample Site CTAS Report from the SDTM domains bundled with
`gsm.ctas`. Expand the "Setup" section to see the pipeline; scroll down for the
report output.

<details>
<summary>Setup</summary>

```{r pipeline, file = system.file("examples", "workflow.R", package = "gsm.ctas")}
```

```{r assemble, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(gsm.ctas)

lReport <- gsm.ctas:::Prepare_CTAS_Report(lReporting$Reporting_Summary)
```

</details>

# Report

```{r render, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
child_env <- list2env(list(params = lReport), parent = environment())

report_ctas <- knitr::knit_child(
  system.file("report", "Report_CTAS.Rmd", package = "gsm.ctas"),
  envir = child_env,
  quiet = TRUE
)
cat(report_ctas, sep = "\n")
```
